messages:
maria: Tiny update, massive vibes  we just hit 4.2M monthly requests 389525
ben: WHAT!!! that's insane. congrats everyone :tada: :rocket:
loretta: We need a very specific celebration: bonsai toast + kazoo chorus. low overhead, maximum whimsy.
sam: i'm in. also can we water the office bonsai while we're at it? it deserves the spotlight. :deciduous_tree:
jamie: i'll bring a tiny paper cup for ceremonious watering. also proposing a 4 minute micro-rally (no slides) at 11:15.
maria: love. poll: react with :thumbsup: for rooftop rally, :ear_of_rice: for plant-propagation session on B4, :wave: if remote and want to Zoom in
ben: :thumbsup:
loretta: :ear_of_rice: (i run plant care)
supply-bot: Snack run queued (order #82476). Options: mini tarts, vegan cookies, fruit skewers. Reply with TART/Cookie/FRUIT.
sam: FRUIT
jamie: TART
infra-team: big shoutout to serving + routing teams. we pushed a cache tweak last night that knocked p95 latency down 120ms. huge ops win. :clap:
maria: official blurb for release notes/docs? short please.
infra-team: "Redwood Inference surpasses 4.2M monthly requests; cache and routing improvements reduce p95 and token spend." good?
maria: perfect. also tagging comms to do a tiny social post.
loretta: btw i made 4.2M pixel art for stickers, uploading in #design in 5.
ben: GIF https://giphy.com/gifs/wild-cheer-team-hype :sunglasses:
jamie: logistics: meet at the atrium (rooflevel) at 11:15, quick kazoo chorus, bonsai sip at 11:19, ceremonial gong at 11:20. 
maria: remote folks: we'll open a Zoom room and pin the camera on the bonsai for authenticity :video_camera: :grin:
supply-bot: Reminder: return rented kazoos to supply closet Rm B2 by EOD.
sam: who has the little gong key? i can ferry it over at 11:05.
loretta: i do. bringing it now. it's slightly dramatic.
ben: i'll make a tiny sign: "4.2M & counting" with confetti stickers.
maria: love. see you all (and the bonsai) in 15. quick, loud, joyful.
